title: Freeze the original 1500-item reviews selection and immutable role manifest
description: Before any S/F screen, preserve approved first1500 pool-order labeling universe rather than dynamically using all1819 cached labels. Add a dedicated text-free self-hashed split manifest with ordered heldout300/stream600/dev100 IDs, normalized text hashes and frozen canonical gold, exact primary SME model/policy/prompt identity, source manifest digest, selection universe digest and algorithm config. Rehydrate only manifest IDs, validate private text/cache hashes/labels/identity and disjointness; unrelated cache growth must not change roles. Existing dynamic loader remains preview only; corpus and review screen require explicit frozen input with no recomputation fallback. One-shot freeze CLI uses predeclared first1500 rule, explicit model/policy/universe digest, refuses overwrite. This is normal implementation of approved plan, not a new tuning/selection search. Specs first with synthetic data; no paid calls, no downloads, no policy/review prose in artifacts. Main freezes actual existing inputs only after review, before screen; do not use heldout errors for selection.
